Red light therapy for skin over 40: what the trials show

brief.angle: Controlled trials of red/near-infrared LED for wrinkles and skin (e.g. Wunsch & Matuschka 2014, Photomed Laser Surg; PMID 24286286), vs. uncontrolled industry studies (e.g. Skin Res Technol 2023, Dior/Lucibel mask, PMC10311288: 20 people, no control group, manufacturer authors). FDA clears some OTC LED masks as Class II for full-face wrinkles (e.g. K214103, 21 CFR 878.4810): clearance is not proof of large effects. Wavelengths tested (630-850 nm), session schedules, eye safety.
